outcome: Time to reach full oral feed
cohort: The study included 102 term neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) who received therapeutic hypothermia treatment.
finding: In neonates with HIE, maternal diabetes is associated with an increased risk of death or short-term neonatal morbidities, including longer ventilation, prolonged NICU stay, greater need for tube feeding, and an abnormal neurological examination at discharge.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of 3,588 g (IDM) vs. 3,214 g (non-IDM)
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth of 38.6 weeks (IDM) vs. 39.7 weeks (non-IDM) for term neonates
